cases.input: Update a mission's learning state after separate evidence shows successful retrieval and later representative application of one competency.
requiredBehaviors: map evidence to the matching competence level
preserve evidence references for every promotion
keep prior knowledge distinct from demonstrated competence
write a concise learning record only for substantive change
forbiddenBehaviors: promote application evidence directly to transfer without novel-context evidence
copy the full raw ETF event stream into every learning record
skillAnchors: Jeder Kompetenzsprung braucht mindestens eine nachvollziehbare Evidenzreferenz
Learning Record nur bei substantieller Änderung erzeugen

cases.input: Earlier work suggested strong knowledge, but a recent representative task shows regression and a previously recorded misconception has now been corrected.
requiredBehaviors: preserve conflicting evidence instead of selecting only the highest historical state
mark the misconception corrected rather than deleting it
record correction evidence and current uncertainty or regression
forbiddenBehaviors: blindly keep the highest prior competence level
skillAnchors: Eine korrigierte Fehlvorstellung wird nicht aus der Historie gelöscht
Bei Konflikten markiere Unsicherheit oder Regression

cases.input: A lesson was read once and a draft state marks the learner transfer-demonstrated and formally qualified, without any assessment evidence.
requiredBehaviors: keep the item introduced at most
forbiddenBehaviors: treat lesson coverage as transfer evidence
